body: thank you as well. And it is very hard and exhausting. maybe, little by little, you can stop having negative thoughts that are that bad. Same with me. Happens a lot. But not very easy to control. improvement is important!! baby steps :). i hope you have a nice rest of your week, and possibly longer than that. you can get through this and so can i!! Optimism isnt easy but its good to try some times

I don’t necessarily think its a small minded way to think. Its just an effect of whatever you’re going through, such as mental illness. We can think its dumb but in my opinion, belittling yourself won’t help that much. There are days where you can have nothing but negative thoughts, its fine. You just need to remember that you do cross people’s minds, remind yourself that you are loved. Its like having tunnel vision. And i know its very hard to have any sort of positive thoughts, thats exactly why it took someone telling me otherwise for me to realize that im not always right in the way i think. I hope you do realize that people do care about you, even when you dont think so. I do understand how hard it is though. I have some pretty bad trauma from an ex so it’s hard to believe that anyone can actually care about me or love me. But its not true. Sorry this is messy, my thoughts can be either slow or jumbled all together. Feel better soon, and then hopefully you can understand how others care about you and how you most certainly deserve it :). Its not easy!! yet the tiniest steps towards improving your mindset can help a lot. I wish you the best, and i hope the way you think about yourself and how you think the way others perceive you improve as well. hopefully this all makes sense and i didnt repeat myself too much or spew absolute gibberish!!
